answer: An escrowed deposit and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 30 units and becomes one node, so 1,000 fakes form a star cluster, not a grove of independent roots. Any peer may dispute a suspect node; audit slashes fake deposits and referrers too. A harbor shelters only verified ships. Faking 1,000 identities costs 30,000 units, more than split rewards. On the tundra, one honest agent pays 30 once and earns an undiluted share.
